Aspera Connect — if something goes wrong
=========================================

PC INSTALL
----------
Problem: .deb won't install / "dependency error"
Fix:     sudo apt update
         sudo apt install ./AsperaConnect-Desktop.deb

Problem: App not in menu after install
Fix:     Log out and log back in, or run: aspera-connect

PHONE INSTALL
-------------
Problem: "Install blocked" / can't install APK
Fix:     Settings → Security → allow install from Chrome (or Files app)
         Download again → open APK → Install

Problem: App installs but calls don't work
Fix:     Open app → allow Phone, Answer calls, Contacts, Notifications
         Tap "Start for calls" — keep the notification

Problem: Phone stops working after a while (OnePlus / Xiaomi / Samsung)
Fix:     Settings → Battery → Aspera Connect → Unrestricted / Don't optimize

CONNECT (PC ↔ PHONE)
--------------------
Problem: "Not connected" / "unreachable" / "no route"
Fix:     1. Phone: Start for calls (notification visible)
         2. PC and phone on SAME Wi-Fi band (both 2.4 OR both 5 GHz)
         3. Copy IP from phone app → paste in PC → Connect
         4. Or click "Find phone on network"

Problem: Worked on 5 GHz, fails on 2.4 GHz (or opposite)
Fix:     IP changes when you switch band — update IP or use Find phone

Problem: "Find phone on network" finds nothing
Fix:     Phone must show "Start for calls" / Waiting
         Same office network (not guest Wi-Fi)
         Try entering IP manually from phone screen

Problem: Connected before, stopped working
Fix:     Phone may have closed the service — open app → Start for calls again
         Check phone battery optimization (see above)

USING THE APP
-------------
Problem: "Call from clipboard" fails
Fix:     Linux Mint:  sudo apt install xclip
         KDE/Wayland: sudo apt install wl-clipboard
         Copy a phone number first, then tray → Call from clipboard

Problem: Zoho / browser phone link doesn't dial
Fix:     1. PC app open and Connected (sidebar shows Linked)
         2. Click "Make Aspera handle tel: links" once
         3. Try the link again

Problem: Contacts empty / sync failed
Fix:     Allow Contacts on phone → Connect again → Sync from phone

Problem: Hang up doesn't work
Fix:     On phone allow "Answer/end calls" permission → try again

Still stuck?
------------
Note: phone model, PC version (Linux Mint?), error text on red banner
Send to IT / Shree with a screenshot.
